name: 5-10-5 Pro Agility Shuttle
description: Change-of-direction shuttle — gold standard test of COD for court sports.
instructions_excerpt: Set three cones 5 yards apart in a line. Start at the middle cone. Sprint 5 yards to one side, touch the line, sprint 10 yards to the far cone, touch, sprint 5 yards back through the middle. 3-4 runs per direction.

name: 5-10-5 Pro Agility Shuttle
description: Short-distance shuttle — the NFL/NBA combine staple. Tests and trains change-of-direction speed in every team sport.
instructions_excerpt: Set three cones in a line, 5 yards apart. Straddle the middle cone. Sprint 5 yards one way, touch the line, sprint 10 yards the other way, touch, sprint back through the middle. Rest fully.

name: A-Skip to Sprint
description: Acceleration drill — starts with A-skip rhythm, then transitions to full sprint.
instructions_excerpt: Start with 5-10m of A-skips (high knee drive, dorsiflexed foot). On the coach's call — or after a set number of skips — transition to a 10-20m max-effort sprint.

name: Agility Ladder Icky Shuffle
description: Fast in-in-out ladder drill — footwork quickness and coordination for racquet court movement.
instructions_excerpt: Set up an agility ladder. Step in-in-out pattern: left foot in, right foot in, left foot out to the side. Next square: right-left-right out. Move through the length of the ladder quickly. 3-4 passes.

name: Agility Ladder In-Out
description: Agility-ladder footwork drill — fast-feet training for basketball, soccer, and hockey footwork.
instructions_excerpt: With an agility ladder flat on ground, move through with the in-in-out-out pattern (both feet in each square, then both feet out straddling). Work length of ladder, reset.

name: American Kettlebell Swing
description: Overhead kettlebell swing — CrossFit staple. Higher finish than Russian swing.
instructions_excerpt: Hike the kettlebell back between legs. Snap the hips forward and drive the kettlebell overhead, arms locking out by ears. Control the descent back between the legs.

name: Beach-Tennis Sand-Sprint Lunge
description: Forward lunge on sand with a racquet follow-through — beach-tennis specific load pattern.
instructions_excerpt: In sand, lunge forward aggressively, reaching with a light racquet or paddle. Push back explosively. 8-10 per side.

name: BMX Sprint Stand Starts
description: Short maximal standing sprints on a bike — BMX gate-style explosive torque output.
instructions_excerpt: From a standing stop, crank 8-12 hard strokes out of the saddle. Accelerate, then sit and roll. Rest fully. 6-8 reps.

name: BMX Standing Start Sprint Drill
description: Explosive standing-start sprint specific to BMX gate starts and track launches.
instructions_excerpt: From a split-stance standing position, explode into 10-15 m sprint as if clearing a BMX gate. Walk back, full recovery. 4-6 reps.

name: Board Pop-Up on Foam
description: Board pop-up on foam pad — progression drill for stand-up paddling, surf, wake.
instructions_excerpt: Lie prone on a soft foam pad. Push up explosively to a stable stance as if on a board. Hold 2-3s. Lower and reset. 8-10 reps.

name: Box Jump
description: Lower-body power expression — useful for dynamic climbing foundations.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in front of a plyo box 1-2 feet away. Load the hips by dropping into a quarter squat, then explode upward, swinging the arms, and land softly on top of the box with feet flat and knees slightly bent. Stand tall. Step down (do not jump down).

name: Box Jump Over
description: Plyo box jump with additional lateral traversal — CrossFit-style conditioning.
instructions_excerpt: Jump onto the box, then step or jump down on the opposite side. Turn around and repeat. Maintain quiet landings.

name: Box Jump to Stick (Soft Landing)
description: Box jump with an emphasis on landing mechanics — primer for ski-drop absorption and XC/skimo transitions.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in front of a sturdy box. Load the hips, swing arms, jump to the center of the box and stick the landing soft in an athletic stance. Step (not jump) down. Reset every rep.

name: Broad Jump
description: Horizontal power output — ground-reaction training.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with feet hip-width. Load the hips into a quarter squat with arms back; explosively extend hips and swing arms forward to launch as far as possible. Land softly with bent knees.

name: Cable Low-to-High Chop
description: Diagonal rotational pull from low anchor to overhead — mimics the paddle catch lifting out of the water.
instructions_excerpt: Anchor a cable low. Stand sideways to the stack, grip with both hands at hip. Pivot the back foot and drive the handle diagonally up and across to the opposite shoulder. Return slow and controlled.

name: Cable Punch / Chest Press Rotation
description: Single-arm cable press with rotation — mimics the mechanics of a straight punch with resistance through the full extension.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in a staggered stance facing away from a cable stack at chest height. Hold the handle in the back-side hand at the shoulder. Punch forward and across the body, rotating the torso and back hip as you extend. Return under control. 8-10 per side.

name: Clean & Jerk
description: Full clean from the floor followed by a jerk overhead — total-body Olympic lift.
instructions_excerpt: Clean the bar from the floor to the front rack. Recover. Dip and drive the bar overhead in a push jerk or split jerk. Stand to finish with bar locked out.

name: Comp-Climbing Parkour Dyno
description: Powerful horizontal dyno from one handhold to another across a gap — bread-and-butter for boulder/comp style.
instructions_excerpt: Set up between two sturdy holds (campus rungs, rings, or a comp-wall setup) 3-5 ft apart. From a hang, explosively swing and launch sideways to the other hold. Match, then reset.

name: Cone Cutting Drill (T-Drill)
description: Four-cone T-shape cutting drill — multi-planar agility combining forward sprint, lateral shuffle, and backpedal.
instructions_excerpt: Set cones in a T (top bar 10 yards, stem 10 yards). Sprint stem to middle cone, shuffle right to end cone, shuffle across to opposite cone, shuffle back to middle, backpedal to start.

name: Crew-Jump Box Drill
description: Single-leg box drill simulating boat-to-boat jumps — keelboat/dinghy crew agility.
instructions_excerpt: Stand next to a low box. Jump up onto it with one leg, land, step off. Alternate sides. 6-8 per side.

name: Cross-Over Step
description: Court-movement drill — crossover step for rapid direction change.
instructions_excerpt: Stand sideways to your target. Push off the outside foot and drive the inside leg across the body, rotating hips and running 3-5 steps. Reset. Alternate directions.

name: Deceleration Drop-Step
description: Drop-step deceleration to change direction — critical for dog handlers and any reactive-sport athlete.
instructions_excerpt: Jog 10-15 ft to a cone. At the cone, drop the outside foot back, sink into the hips, and explode in the new direction. Focus on quiet, absorbed steps.

name: Depth Drop to Stick
description: Step off a box and absorb the landing — dedicated deceleration training without the reactive jump-up of a depth jump.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a 12-18" box. Step off (don't jump). Land with both feet, immediately stick the landing: knees bent, hips back, chest up, quiet feet. Hold the landing 2-3 seconds. Step off and reset. 4-6 reps.

name: Depth Jump
description: Reactive plyo — drop from height, absorb, immediately jump vertically for explosive reactive strength.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a 12-18" box. Step off (do not jump off). On landing, spend as little ground-contact time as possible and explode vertically into a max jump.

name: Dodgeball Duck-and-Throw Drill
description: Duck-to-throw transition — dodgeball/kickball quick evasion + release.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with a light ball. Duck quickly, rise, and throw hard toward a target. Reset. 5-10 reps.

name: Dog-Agility Call Drill (Handler)
description: Handler agility drill — short sprint to marker + call to dog — dog-agility handler fitness.
instructions_excerpt: Set three markers in a triangle 10 m apart. Sprint to one, call dog, cross to another. 4-6 circuits.

name: Dog-Agility Handler Sprint-Turn
description: Short sprint-and-turn drill at handler pace — dog-agility handler conditioning.
instructions_excerpt: Sprint 5-10 m, plant, turn 180 degrees, sprint back. 6-10 reps.

name: Dot Drill (5-Dot)
description: Five-dot reactive footwork drill — foot-speed, quickness, and coordination for all team sports.
instructions_excerpt: Tape 5 dots in an X pattern (four corners + center, ~18" apart). Hop through patterns (front-back, side-side, scissor) for 10-15 sec per round.

name: Drop to Vertical Jump
description: Step-off from a box immediately into a max vertical jump — reactive-strength primer before full depth jumps.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a 6-12" box. Step off. On landing, immediately jump vertically for max height. Aim to minimize ground-contact time.

name: Explosive Pull-Up
description: Concentric-focused pull-up aiming for max bar speed.
instructions_excerpt: Set up like a strict pull-up. Pull as fast as possible so that the chest comes to the bar or higher. Lower under control for 1-2 seconds. Rest fully between reps.

name: Fencing Footwork Ladder
description: Advance / retreat / lunge pattern through a ladder — fencing footwork precision.
instructions_excerpt: Lay an agility ladder on the floor. Advance, advance, retreat, lunge out of the last rung. Build to reverse patterns. 3-5 rounds.

name: Flag-Football Pull-Defense Cut
description: Agile break-and-cut drill specific to flag-football defensive angles.
instructions_excerpt: From a 5-yard base, sprint forward 3 steps, drop hips, cut 90 degrees left, then right. 6-8 reps.

name: Forward-Leaning Run-Launch Drill
description: Dryland forward-leaning run drill simulating a paraglide launch.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a light pole or yoke with arms outstretched overhead simulating risers. Lean forward aggressively and run 10-20 m as if taking off. Reset. 5-8 launches.

name: Freestyle-Ski Landing Squat-Jump
description: Jump landing absorption drill — bread and butter for freestyle/park skiing and boardsports.
instructions_excerpt: Jump off a box (12-18 in), land soft into a quarter squat and absorb, holding 1-2 sec. Step up and repeat. 5-8 reps.

name: Grand Battement (Kick Prep)
description: Ballet-style high kick — hamstring and hip-flexor power for dance.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with one hand on a wall/barre. Kick the free leg forward as high as possible with a straight knee and pointed foot. Lower with control. 8-10 per direction per side.

name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Rotation
description: Half-kneeling rotational drive through the landmine — hip-driven rotation is the paddle stroke's engine.
instructions_excerpt: Half-kneel perpendicular to the landmine. Hold the bar sleeve with both hands at one shoulder. Drive the bar across the body to the opposite shoulder by rotating through the torso. Return slow.

name: Hang Clean
description: Power clean from the hang — bar starts at mid-thigh, no floor pull.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with bar at mid-thigh. Hinge slightly, then explode by extending hips, knees, ankles. Shrug, pull under, and catch the bar on the shoulders in a partial squat.

name: Hang Power Clean
description: Clean from the hang position (mid-thigh) caught in a partial squat — builds triple extension without the pull from the floor.
instructions_excerpt: Set up with feet hip-width, bar at mid-thigh, chest up, shoulders slightly in front of the bar. Drive the hips forward powerfully and shrug, pulling under the bar to catch it on the front rack in a quarter squat. Stand tall.

name: Highland Games Caber Sim (Sandbag Flip)
description: Long sandbag lift and flip — simulates the caber toss of highland games.
instructions_excerpt: Stand a long sandbag upright. Hoist it onto the shoulder, then with a run-up, release the bag forward into a vertical flip. 3-5 reps.

name: Hill Sprint on Bike
description: Short uphill sprints on bike — VO2 and neuromuscular power.
instructions_excerpt: Find a 30-60s hill. Sprint up at near-max effort. Roll down to recover. 4-8 reps.

name: Ice Tool Swing (Rotational Med-Ball)
description: Rotational med-ball swing simulating ice-tool stick — the closest dryland mimic of the axe swing.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a light med-ball (6-10 lb) at chest. Rotate the torso up-and-across, swinging the ball overhead and down with the rotating elbow finishing high. Catch, reset, repeat. Switch sides.

name: Jump Rope Double-Unders (Ski Foot-Quickness)
description: High-output jump rope work — doubles as ski and skate foot-quickness plus calf/achilles prehab.
instructions_excerpt: Jump rope with two passes of the rope per jump. Stay on the balls of the feet, small jump, flick with the wrists (no shoulder sweep). 30-60 sec bouts.

name: Jump-Turn Pop-Up (180°)
description: Pop-up with a 180° rotation in mid-air — advanced surfer drill training landing in either stance.
instructions_excerpt: Pop up explosively as in a standard pop-up, rotating 180° in the air to land facing the opposite direction in a surf stance. Absorb the landing.

name: Jumping Switch Lunge (TKD Power)
description: Scissor jump switching lunge feet mid-air — taekwondo and capoeira leg-speed staple.
instructions_excerpt: From a split-stance, jump and switch feet mid-air. Land softly. 20 total jumps (10 per lead leg).

name: Kettlebell Clean (Single-Arm)
description: Kettlebell clean — explosive hip hinge that teaches the sprawl-to-stand and takedown-reversal timing.
instructions_excerpt: Start with KB between feet. Hike pass into a single-arm clean, catching the bell in the rack position. Lower under control to a relaxed swing between the legs. Repeat. 5-8 reps per side.

name: Kettlebell Snatch Sets
description: High-rep kettlebell snatch sets — kettlebell-sport specific endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Snatch a moderate KB (16-24 kg) 10-15 reps per side, alternating each set. 5-10 sets total. Rest as needed.

name: Kitesurf Edge-Set Drop Squat
description: Quick drop into eccentric half-squat — kitesurf edge-set and board-control absorption.
instructions_excerpt: From tall stance, drop into a quarter squat absorbing in 1-2 sec, then rise. 10-12 reps.

name: Krav-Maga 360-Defense Drill
description: Rapid arm-block drill against 360-degree attacks — central Krav Maga reactive pattern.
instructions_excerpt: Partner or pad-holder simulates attacks from different angles (or set cones at 8 directions). Step off-line and block-strike to each direction. 30-60s rounds.

name: Krav-Maga Combative 3-Strike Burst
description: Rapid 3-strike burst under stress — Krav Maga tactical conditioning.
instructions_excerpt: From neutral, on a timer cue, deliver 3 strikes: palm-hammer, knee, elbow — as fast as possible. Reset to neutral. 10 bursts.

name: Landing Squat Absorption Drill
description: Low-height drop + absorb to a squat — trains the eccentric landing mechanics needed for paragliding/hang-gliding touchdowns.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a 6-12" box. Step off (don't jump). Absorb the landing softly into a quarter-squat with bent knees, immediately re-stabilize. Hold the landing for 2 seconds before stepping back up.

name: Landmine Rotation
description: Landmine rotational anti-extension with ballistic finish — core rotation under load, specific to punching and clinch work.
instructions_excerpt: Stand holding the end of a landmine barbell at chest height with both hands. Keep elbows slightly bent and feet wide. Rotate the bar from one hip to the other by pivoting the back foot and driving from the hips. Pause each side. 6-10 reps per direction.

name: Landmine Rotational Press
description: Rotational landmine press — full kinetic chain, racquet-swing-specific loaded rotation.
instructions_excerpt: Hold the end of a landmine bar at shoulder height with both hands, weight to one side. Rotate the hips and press the bar up and across the body to the opposite side. Return under control. 6-8 per side.

name: Lateral Bound to Stick
description: Lateral plyo — pushes off one leg, lands on the other, sticks — trains the side-to-side push-off of stance changes and slips.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg. Explosively push off laterally, landing on the opposite leg in athletic stance. Stick the landing for 2s before rebounding. 5-6 per direction.

name: Lateral Bound to Stick
description: Single-leg lateral hop with stuck landing — skating-specific power and landing control.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg. Push off laterally and leap sideways as far as possible, landing on the opposite leg. Hold the landing for 2 seconds before the next rep.

name: Lateral Box Jump (Over)
description: Frontal-plane plyometric — builds the lateral edge-change power that carving skiing and snowboarding demand.
instructions_excerpt: Stand to the side of a low box. Jump laterally up and over the box, landing soft on the far side with a quiet athletic stance. Step around (not jump back) to reset. Build from a 12 in box up.

name: Lateral Deceleration Drill
description: Sprint-and-stop footwork drill — teaches safe lateral deceleration, the most common ACL-injury mechanism in soccer and basketball.
instructions_excerpt: Set two cones 8-10 yards apart. Accelerate laterally toward one cone, then decelerate into a wide athletic stance (hips back, knees bent, chest up). Hold for a 1-count. Reset and repeat.

name: Lateral Shuffle / Agility Line
description: Side-to-side footwork drill — essential for reactive court/field movement.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in an athletic stance between two lines ~4-6 feet apart. Shuffle rapidly side-to-side, touching each line. 20-30 seconds per bout.

name: Masters-Sprint Flying 20
description: Flying 20-meter sprint with rolling start — age-friendly sprint work without max-accel risk.
instructions_excerpt: Build to near-max speed over 20-30 m, then maintain through a 20 m flying zone. Walk back. 4-6 reps.

name: Med Ball Chest Pass (Explosive)
description: Horizontal chest pass for explosive upper-body push — basketball outlet pass and football pushing power.
instructions_excerpt: Stand 6-10 feet from a wall. Hold a med ball at the chest. Explosively push the ball into the wall with both hands, extending fully. Catch the rebound and repeat without pause.

name: Med Ball Shot Put
description: Rotational power throw mimicking the serve motion.
instructions_excerpt: Stand sideways to a wall. Hold a med ball at the shoulder (as if about to shot-put). Rotate hips and push the ball into the wall with an explosive press. Catch rebound and repeat.
